## Plan: RTL support + browser-locale auto-detect for docs site

VitePress already computes `dir` per locale in `docs/.vitepress/i18n.ts` (`ar`/`fa`/`he` = `rtl`, sourced from `@pantoken/i18n`'s `CANVAS_LOCALES`), but [config.ts](docs/.vitepress/config.ts#L250-L256) never passes it through — every page renders `dir="ltr"`. Separately, add a first-visit/every-page browser-locale redirect gated by storage preferences.

*Phase 1 — native RTL wiring*

Fix hardcoded physical CSS in hand-authored theme files to logical properties (no new PostCSS dependency): [ThemeSelector.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/ThemeSelector.vue), [VPHomeHero.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPHomeHero.vue), [VPNavBarExtra.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/VPNavBarExtra.vue), [Layout.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/Layout.vue#L55-56), [pantoken.css](docs/.vitepress/theme/pantoken.css#L95).
